0022600108.text: The Wizards (1-1, 5th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back) are on a one-game losing streak as they visit the Bulls (1-1, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 1 game back), who are riding a one-game winning streak and are 1-1 on the road. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Wizards lost all three games to the Bulls in 2025-26, and their last meeting, on April 9, 2026 in Washington, ended with the Wizards losing 119-108.
